description: Header file defining the DeviceEffectManager class and its callback, related to managing audio effects within Android's AudioFlinger component.

classes.name: DeviceEffectManager
classes.description: Manages device effects within AudioFlinger, including effect creation, removal, and interaction with hardware effects.

classes.name: DeviceEffectManagerCallback
classes.description: Callback interface for device effect management, providing effect hal creation and other effect-related functionalities.

methods.name: createEffect_l
methods.description: Creates an audio effect with specified descriptor, device, client, and patches.

methods.name: createEffectHal
methods.description: Creates an effect HAL instance based on UUID, session, and device ID.

methods.name: addEffectToHal
methods.description: Adds an effect to hardware via AudioFlinger.

methods.name: removeEffectFromHal
methods.description: Removes an effect from hardware via AudioFlinger.

methods.name: onCreateAudioPatch
methods.description: Handles creation of an audio patch.

methods.name: onReleaseAudioPatch
methods.description: Handles release of an audio patch.
